articles.author: Jennifer Jett
articles.title: Lawmaker reportedly loses leg as car ramming stuns Australia - NBC News
articles.description: An Australian lawmaker was in critical but stable condition Tuesday after being hit by a car in what authorities said was a deliberate attack, shocking a nation where political violence is extremely rare.
articles.content:
Political violence is extremely rare in Australia, where lawmakers are often out in public with little or no security and their accessibility is a point of national pride.
